# SC-900 Practice Section 2

[![Open in Quiz Player](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open_in-Quiz_Player-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](https://quizplay.io/quiz.html?source=quizplay-io/quiz-player-quizzes-sc-900-question-set-2)

![Preview](assets/images/preview_sc900.svg)

Second practice question set for the **Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)** certification exam. This set covers Zero Trust principles such as assume breach and identity as the security perimeter; Microsoft Entra capabilities including B2B collaboration, managed identities, passwordless authentication, lifecycle workflows, and Privileged Identity Management; Microsoft security solutions such as Azure Firewall, the Defender XDR family, Microsoft Security Copilot, and Defender Threat Intelligence; and Microsoft Purview compliance solutions including retention, auditing, insider risk management, Microsoft Priva, and unified data governance.

## Content Overview

- **36 Questions** — 12 case-study questions across 4 fictional scenarios, plus 24 standalone questions; single choice, multiple choice, ordering, and matching
- **Topics**:
  - Describe the concepts of security, compliance, and identity (10–15%)
  - Describe the capabilities of Microsoft Entra (25–30%)
  - Describe the capabilities of Microsoft security solutions (35–40%)
  - Describe the capabilities of Microsoft compliance solutions (20–25%)

## What This Does Not Cover

This question set focuses on **foundational security, compliance, and identity concepts**. It does not cover hands-on portal configuration, PowerShell or CLI commands, or the deep implementation detail tested in associate-level exams such as SC-300 or AZ-500. It is not a substitute for official Microsoft Learn training paths.

## Disclaimer

> [!IMPORTANT]
> These questions are **AI-generated** for study and practice purposes. They are **not** exam dumps and do not contain actual questions from the Microsoft certification exam. Use them to test your understanding of security, compliance, and identity concepts, not as a substitute for official study materials.

## Usage

This repository is designed to be used with the [Quiz Player](https://quizplay.io). Click the badge above to launch the quiz directly.
